cards.front: 41. You can go to the theatre with us _____ you can go there alone.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. or = hoặc.

Hai lựa chọn thay thế nhau → dùng “or”.

cards.front: 42. He invested a lot of money in this business, _____ it went bankrupt in a very short time.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. but = nhưng.

Hai mệnh đề mang ý tương phản.

cards.front: 43. It rained heavily, _____ the show was cancelled.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. so = vì vậy.

Mưa lớn → kết quả là buổi diễn bị hủy.

cards.front: 44. The students didn’t revise for their exams, _____ did they realise how important the exams were.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. nor.

Sau mệnh đề phủ định, “nor” nối thêm một ý phủ định và kéo theo đảo ngữ: nor did they realise...

cards.front: 45. Peter wonders he should stay home and watch TV, _____ he should go out and have dinner with his friends.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. or = hoặc.

Hai khả năng lựa chọn → dùng “or”.

cards.front: 46. The boys are playing games, _____ the girls are watching TV.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. and = và.

Hai hành động song song/bổ sung thông tin.

cards.front: 47. Linda practices singing every day _____ she wants to become a singer.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. for = vì/bởi vì.

Mệnh đề sau nêu lý do.

cards.front: 48. The show was postponed _____ the singer had a serious accident.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. for = vì/bởi vì.

Mệnh đề sau giải thích nguyên nhân buổi diễn bị hoãn.

cards.front: 49. I tried my best in the final test, _____ the result was not as good as I expected.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. but = nhưng.

Cố gắng hết sức nhưng kết quả không như mong đợi → tương phản.

cards.front: 50. She loves comedies, _____ her husband is interested in action films.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. yet = tuy nhiên/nhưng.

Hai sở thích đối lập.

cards.front: 51. My family really loves Japanese food, _____ we order it twice a week.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. so = vì vậy.

Yêu thích đồ ăn Nhật → kết quả là đặt món hai lần mỗi tuần.

cards.front: 52. Van Cao was a gifted composer, _____ he won many national prizes, including Ho Chi Minh prize.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. and = và.

Mệnh đề sau bổ sung thêm thông tin về Văn Cao.

cards.front: 53. I should practice more for the competition, _____ my health hasn't been excellent recently.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. but = nhưng.

Nên luyện tập nhiều hơn nhưng sức khỏe gần đây không tốt → tương phản.

cards.front: 54. You can go to the movies with me, _____ you can go to the concert alone.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. or = hoặc.

Hai lựa chọn thay thế nhau.

cards.front: 55. Would you like to go to the cinema _____ watch at home?
cards.explanation:
✓ B. or = hay.

Dùng giữa hai lựa chọn.

cards.front: 56. She has a potential voice, _____ she doesn’t intend to pursue a career in music.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. but = nhưng.

Có giọng hát tiềm năng nhưng không định theo nghề âm nhạc → tương phản.

cards.front: 57. He has an emotive voice _____ skillful performance.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. and = và.

Nối hai đặc điểm bổ sung: emotive voice + skillful performance.

cards.front: 58. John’s voice is nice, _____ his performance style is not good enough.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. but = nhưng.

Giọng hay nhưng phong cách biểu diễn chưa tốt → tương phản.

cards.front: 59. This singer was nominated for 10 Grammys, _____ he won two.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. but = nhưng.

Được đề cử 10 giải nhưng chỉ thắng 2 → tương phản.

cards.front: 60. Mike was a famous singer, _____ he had a bad singing voice.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. but = nhưng.

Nổi tiếng nhưng giọng hát tệ → tương phản.

cards.front: 61. Close the window _____ turn off the lights when you leave the room.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. and = và.

Nối hai mệnh lệnh/hành động cần thực hiện.

cards.front: 62. His performance was dull, _____ I fell asleep.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. so = vì vậy.

Buổi biểu diễn buồn tẻ → kết quả là tôi ngủ quên.

cards.front: 63. She wanted to become a violinist, _____ her parents didn’t allow.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. yet = nhưng/tuy nhiên.

Mong muốn trở thành nghệ sĩ violin nhưng bố mẹ không cho phép → tương phản.

cards.front: 64. The show was fascinating at the beginning, _____ it got dull later.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. yet = nhưng/tuy nhiên.

Ban đầu hấp dẫn nhưng sau đó trở nên buồn tẻ → tương phản.
